web:adafruit-3548.title: DIY HDMI Cable Parts - Straight HDMI Plug Adapter
web:adafruit-3548.note: 27.5 x 17.3 x 5.0 mm, 3.2 g; mates the ribbon through 'flex cable clips'. The page gives no FPC socket part number, pin count, pitch or pinout; it says unnecessary pins may not be connected and quotes one customer report that pin 14 is not connected through. No download, Eagle/PCB or datasheet link on the page; it links only the Learn guides https://learn.adafruit.com/products/3548/guides and the ribbons 3560/3561/3588.

web:adafruit-3550.title: DIY HDMI Cable Parts - Right Angle (L Bend) HDMI Plug Adapter
web:adafruit-3550.note: 19.0 x 17.0 x 15.0 mm. No FPC pinout, socket part number, pin count or pitch on the page; the description only says the adapters are swapped 'using the flex cable clips'.

web:adafruit-3560.title: DIY USB or HDMI Cable Parts - 10 cm Ribbon Cable
web:adafruit-3560.note: Cable length 100 mm, width 10 mm, 0.6 g; adapters sold separately; 'not going to be as durable or shielded as ready-made cables'. Conductor count, pitch, contact side, pinout and the mating connector MPN are not listed.

web:core-electronics-forum-13976.title: Pinout for DIY HDMI Cable Parts - Right Angle (R bend) HDMI Plug Adapter (thread of 2022-05-05)
web:core-electronics-forum-13976.note: The asker found no pinout at Adafruit or by search; the distributor reply (2022-05-05) says no pinout was received from Adafruit for that connector, recommends mapping it by continuity with a multimeter and says all DIY HDMI cable parts are interchangeable. No pinout and no FPC connector part number in the thread.

web:digikey-forum-58769.title: Type of flex cable to use with STRAIGHT HDMI PLUG ADAPTER (thread of 2025-08-14)
web:digikey-forum-58769.note: The asker could not find any information on the FPC connectors and pin count; the replies point to the Adafruit ribbons 3561/3562 (DigiKey 1528-2375-ND for 3561) and give no connector part number, pin count, pitch or pinout.
